items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: He used to give Sunday afternoon jam sessions and he always had me on the sessions and Lester and Nat King Cole.

ctx.x: Well I had known Norman when I was with Basie. I used to know him out in California around Billy Berg's place. He used to give Sunday afternoon jam sessions and he always had me on the sessions and Lester and Nat King Cole.
